publish.title: Original Anime Hero: 2D Artwork Contest
publish.prize: US$500 in gift cards for the winner + featured on the anime.support home page
publish.description:
Create the key art for a brand-new anime protagonist of your own: a character sheet, a key visual or a full illustration. Show us who they are, what world they live in and what makes their story worth watching.

Any 2D medium: digital painting, cel shading, line art, watercolour scans. One image per entrant.

Dates: entries open 10 December and close 20 December. Public voting runs 21–24 December, and the winner is announced on 25 December.

Prize: US$500 in gift cards for the winner, plus a feature on the anime.support home page.

publish.title: Mecha or Magic: 3D Character Contest
publish.prize: US$2,000 for the winner: US$1,500 paid by transfer + a US$500 gift card
publish.description:
Sculpt or model an original anime-style character: a mecha pilot, the mecha itself, or a magical fighter in full outfit.

Upload a GLB file (people can spin it in 3D right on the page), or a turntable video or rendered image. Keep it under 25 MB.

Dates: entries open 10 December and close 20 December. Public voting runs 21–24 December, and the winner is announced on 25 December.

Prize: US$2,000 for the winner, made up of US$1,500 sent by bank transfer (or Payoneer/Wise) and a US$500 gift card, plus a feature on the anime.support home page.
